applies_to_institution: Technische Universitaet Berlin|Charite - Universitaetsmedizin Berlin|Freie Universitaet Berlin|Humboldt-Universitaet zu Berlin
applies_to_programs: Urban Management - UM (MSc 18 months TU Berlin)|Master of Science in International Health (MSc 12 months Charite Berlin/FU Berlin/HU Berlin)
amount_notes: 992 EUR/month for graduates (1300 EUR/month for doctoral candidates; 1400 EUR from Feb 2026). Plus health/accident/personal-liability insurance contributions and a travel allowance unless covered elsewhere. Possible monthly rent subsidy and family allowance. Berlin public universities charge no tuition so the stipend is effectively net living money.
duration_covered: 12 to 42 months depending on the study programme (TU Berlin Urban Management = 18 months)
nationality_restrictions: Only nationals of countries on the DAAD/OECD-DAC developing-country list for EPOS
tunisia_eligible_evidence: "Graduates with at least two years' professional experience from the following countries: list of eligible countries" - the DAC list names under NORTH AFRICA: Algeria, Egypt, Libya, Morocco, Tunesia.
other_eligibility: Bachelor (normally four-year) in a related subject; degree in the upper third of the class; AT LEAST TWO YEARS of relevant professional experience after the first degree at the time of application; degree not more than six years old; not resident in Germany >15 months at the deadline. Max 3 courses per applicant.
application_window: Set by each individual EPOS course, not by the DAAD; applications go directly to the course. Current list is 'List of all Postgraduate courses with application deadlines 2027/2028' (Stand 06/2026).
deadline: Course-specific - see the DAAD EPOS deadlines list for 2027/2028; TU Berlin Urban Management and Charite International Health both say 'see website of the course'
apply_via: Directly to the chosen postgraduate course (NOT to the DAAD) using the DAAD EPOS application form + checklist
red_flags: THE TWO-YEAR PROFESSIONAL-EXPERIENCE BAR IS ABSOLUTE - a 2027 graduate straight out of the engineering diploma is NOT eligible. Only 2 Berlin courses exist and neither is software/music. German-track courses require B1 German at application and DSH-2/TestDaF-4 before the course starts.
notes: German-language proficiency IS a funding condition for German-taught EPOS courses (B1 certificate at application, DSH 2 / TestDaF 4 before study start; a 6-month German course in Germany is included). For English-taught courses only English per course rules. Both Berlin courses are English-taught. Realistic only if the client works 2+ years before applying.

scholarship_name: DAAD Study Scholarships - Master Studies for All Academic Disciplines
scholarship_name_original: DAAD-Studienstipendien - Masterstudien fuer alle wissenschaftlichen Faecher
applies_to_city: any (Germany, incl. all Berlin state universities)
amount_notes: 992 EUR/month, plus insurance contributions, travel allowance on application, annual study allowance of 460 EUR, possible rent subsidy, Green Mobility top-up, funded online language course and 2/4/6-month German course before the study visit.
nationality_restrictions: Restricted to a closed country list which is essentially Europe, the CIS, and industrialised countries
tunisia_eligible_evidence: Country selector lists Afghanistan...Syria, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, Ukraine, UK, USA, Uzbekistan, Yemen - Tunisia is absent. "If your status and/or country is not included in the list, you cannot apply for this scholarship programme."
other_eligibility: First degree by the start of funding; last degree not older than 6 years; not resident in Germany >15 months at deadline.
application_window: 1 June to the country-specific deadline (for funding starting 1 October 2027)
deadline: Not applicable for Tunisia - no deadline is served when Tunisia is selected as country of origin
red_flags: CLOSED TO TUNISIANS. DAAD's own overview says master's study scholarships are 'available, in particular, for persons from industrial countries'. Do not waste an application cycle here.
notes: Logged specifically so the client does not chase it. DAAD routes developing/emerging-country applicants to EPOS and the STEM study scholarships instead - but see FBE-007: the STEM line also excludes Tunisia. Language condition would have been proficiency in the language of instruction only (German OR English), not German per se.

applies_to_institution: any state Musikhochschule (Berlin: Universitaet der Kuenste Berlin / Hochschule fuer Musik Hanns Eisler Berlin)
applies_to_programs: Master / postgraduate music degree (2nd cycle) or Konzertexamen/Meisterklasse (3rd cycle)|Advanced studies without a degree
amount_notes: 992 EUR/month, travel allowance on application, one-off study allowance, health/accident/personal-liability insurance contributions, possible rent subsidy and family allowance, Green Mobility top-up, funded online language course plus a 2/4/6-month German course before the study visit.
duration_covered: Degree studies: 2 to 4 semesters (10-24 months). Advanced studies without a degree: 12 months, extendable in individual cases.
nationality_restrictions: Open worldwide - very long country list including Tunisia
tunisia_eligible_evidence: Country selector for this programme includes "...Trinidad and Tobago Tunisia Turkey Turkmenistan Uganda Ukraine..."; DAAD: "Please select your status and your country to enable you to submit an application".
other_eligibility: "you will have obtained a first degree in music by the time the scholarship begins, or you have exhausted all training opportunities for your instrument or subject in your home country if no degree is offered in your country of origin". Last degree <=6 years old; not resident in Germany >15 months. Funds only ARTISTIC projects - musicology/music education/scientific projects are excluded.
application_window: Applications via the DAAD portal; portal opens 1 June and closes on the deadline below
deadline: 24 September 2026 (Bewerbungsschluss 24.09.2026); selection meeting February 2027; funding starts from October 2027
deadline_source_cycle: 2027 cycle - this IS the window for a September/October 2027 start
apply_via: DAAD portal (portal.daad.de) + artistic work samples via the DAAD media database
red_flags: HARD BLOCKER FOR THIS CLIENT: requires a FIRST DEGREE IN MUSIC (or proof that no music degree exists in the home country and all local training has been exhausted). A software-engineering diploma plus a portfolio does not satisfy this. Audition/work-sample gated. Deadline 24 Sept 2026 is roughly one month away.
notes: German is NOT a funding condition per se - DAAD asks only for 'sufficient knowledge of the language of instruction' by the start of the scholarship; a German course is funded if needed and is compulsory only where the course is taught in German. Berlin's state music schools (UdK Berlin, HfM Hanns Eisler) teach mostly in German, which would make German a de-facto condition there.

scholarship_name: DAAD Study Scholarships - Fine Art, Design, Visual Communication and Film
scholarship_name_original: DAAD-Studienstipendien - Bildende Kunst, Design/Visuelle Kommunikation und Film
applies_to_institution: any state or state-recognised German university (Berlin: Universitaet der Kuenste Berlin, weissensee kunsthochschule berlin, Kunsthochschule Berlin-Weissensee)
applies_to_programs: Master/postgraduate degree in Fine Art, Design, Visual Communication or Film|Complementary course without a degree
amount_notes: 992 EUR/month, travel allowance on application, one-off study allowance, health/accident/personal-liability insurance contributions, possible rent subsidy and family allowance, Green Mobility top-up, funded language courses.
duration_covered: 10 to 24 months for a degree course; 12 months for complementary studies
nationality_restrictions: Open worldwide - long country list including Tunisia
tunisia_eligible_evidence: Country selector includes "...Trinidad and Tobago Tunisia Turkey Turkmenistan..." for this programme.
other_eligibility: "You can apply if you have gained a first university degree in the field of arts." Only artistic/creative projects; art history, art studies and restoration are excluded. Last degree <=6 years; not resident in Germany >15 months.
application_window: DAAD portal; opens 1 June, closes on the deadline below. Portfolio submitted in a second step via the DAAD media database after the formal check.
deadline: 15 October 2026 (Bewerbungsschluss 15.10.2026); selection April 2027; funding starts from October 2027
deadline_source_cycle: 2027 cycle - this IS the window for a September/October 2027 start
apply_via: DAAD portal (portal.daad.de) then artistic portfolio via the DAAD media database
red_flags: Requires a first university degree IN THE FIELD OF ARTS - a software-engineering diploma does not qualify on the face of the text. Portfolio-gated (two-stage submission). Deadline 15 Oct 2026.
notes: Closest artistic DAAD line to a sound-design / audiovisual / media-art master's (e.g. UdK Berlin Sound Studies and Sonic Arts sits in the art field). Worth a written eligibility query to DAAD Tunis if the client can argue an arts-field first degree. German is not a stated funding condition; only 'sufficient knowledge of the language of instruction'.

applies_to_institution: any state or state-recognised German university (Berlin: Universitaet der Kuenste Berlin, Hochschule fuer Schauspielkunst Ernst Busch)
applies_to_programs: Master/postgraduate degree in Drama, Theatre Directing/Dramaturgy, Musicals, Performance Studies, Dance, Choreography|Complementary course without a degree
amount_notes: 992 EUR/month, travel allowance on application, one-off study allowance, insurance contributions, possible rent subsidy and family allowance.
duration_covered: 10 to 24 months for a degree course; 12 months for complementary studies
nationality_restrictions: Open worldwide - long country list including Tunisia
tunisia_eligible_evidence: Country selector includes "...Trinidad and Tobago Tunisia Turkey Turkmenistan Uganda..." for this programme.
other_eligibility: "You can apply if you have gained a first university degree in the field of the Performing Arts at the latest by the time you commence your scholarship-supported study programme." Artistic projects only.
application_window: DAAD portal; opens 1 June, closes on the deadline below; work samples in a second step via the DAAD media database
deadline: 15 October 2026 (Bewerbungsschluss 15.10.2026); selection April 2027; funding starts from October 2027
deadline_source_cycle: 2027 cycle - this IS the window for a September/October 2027 start
apply_via: DAAD portal (portal.daad.de) then work samples via the DAAD media database
red_flags: Requires a first university degree in the Performing Arts. Not a route for a software engineer. Logged for completeness of the DAAD artist family.
notes: Listed because the brief asks for the artist lines; performance/live-electronics work would fall here rather than under Music if framed as performance studies. German not a stated funding condition.

scholarship_name: DAAD Helmut-Schmidt-Programme - Master's Scholarships for Public Policy and Good Governance
scholarship_name_original: Helmut-Schmidt-Programm - Master's Scholarships for Public Policy and Good Governance (PPGG)
provider: Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst (DAAD), funded by the Federal Foreign Office
applies_to_institution: seven DAAD-selected German higher education institutions
applies_to_city: Germany (Berlin participation not confirmed in the 2027 call annex read)
applies_to_programs: DAAD-selected English-taught master's courses in Social and Political Sciences, Law, Economics, Public Policy and Administration
amount_notes: 992 EUR/month, health insurance in Germany, lump-sum travel allowances, a study and research grant, rent subsidies and family supplements as applicable. "DAAD scholarship holders are exempt from paying tuition fees." For the Social Protection course a 500 EUR/month sur place rate applies in the online 4th semester.
duration_covered: Duration of the selected master's course, starting September/October 2027, plus a mandatory German language course in Germany of up to 4 months beforehand
nationality_restrictions: Graduates from developing and emerging countries on the OECD-DAC list
tunisia_eligible_evidence: Country selector for this programme lists "...Timor-Leste Togo Tonga Tunisia Turkey Turkmenistan Tuvalu Uganda..."; call text: "Graduates from developing and emerging countries (bachelor or equivalent)".
other_eligibility: Well-qualified first degree with above-average grades (upper third) IN Social and Political Sciences, Law, Economics, Public Policy or Administration; relevant practical experience; degree issued not before 1 January 2020; not more than the past 15 months in a non-DAC country. Max two master's courses per applicant.
application_window: 1 June to 31 July 2026 for the September/October 2027 intake - THIS WINDOW HAS ALREADY CLOSED
deadline_source_cycle: 2027 cycle (official call ST42 Helmut-Schmidt-Programm - Stipendienausschreibung 05/2026) - CLOSED; 2028 cycle expected to open 1 June 2027
apply_via: Directly to the chosen master's course(s), not to the DAAD
red_flags: MISSED FOR 2027: applications closed 31 July 2026. Also a subject mismatch - the first degree must be in social/political science, law, economics or public administration, not engineering. Selection committee met October/November 2026; results December 2026/January 2027.
notes: Language condition: English proficiency is required (all courses are English-taught) BUT a preceding German course in Germany of up to 4 months is COMPULSORY for all scholarship holders - so German study is an obligation of the award even though it is not an entry condition. Recorded because the brief asks for closed schemes too.

scholarship_name: DAAD Study Scholarships for STEM disciplines
applies_to_institution: any state or state-recognised German university offering a tuition-free STEM master's
applies_to_programs: Full-time on-campus master's in mathematics, computer science, natural sciences and engineering
amount_notes: 992 EUR/month, insurance contributions, travel allowance on application, annual study allowance of 460 EUR, possible rent subsidy and family allowance.
duration_covered: 10 to 24 months; funding must begin in 2027, usually 1 October 2027
nationality_restrictions: Closed list of 24 developing and emerging countries
tunisia_eligible_evidence: Full country selector: "Belize Cambodia Colombia Costa Rica Dominican Republic Ecuador El Salvador Ghana Guatemala Honduras Indonesia Jordan Kenya Lao PDR Malaysia Mexico Myanmar Nicaragua Panama Peru Thailand Timor-Leste Venezuela Vietnam" - no Tunisia.
other_eligibility: First degree recognised in Germany by the deadline; must NOT already hold a master's; the target master's must be tuition-free; programmes with integrated stays outside Germany are excluded.
red_flags: CLOSED TO TUNISIANS despite being the perfect subject fit (computer science / engineering master's, 992 EUR/month). This is the single most painful exclusion in the whole Berlin funding map.
notes: Worth re-checking in spring 2027 in case DAAD widens the country list - the list is revised annually. Language condition: proficiency in the language of instruction only.
